meta.name: eu-compliance-directives
meta.description: Curated index of official EU and national (member state) compliance sources, including directives, transposition laws, and regulatory guidance. ACTIVATE when answering questions about EU regulations or national implementations (NIS2, GDPR, DORA, AI Act, Cyberbeveiligingswet, etc.) — especially differences between EU directives and local laws, applicability, enforcement, timelines, or legal obligations. Also activate for conceptual or comparative questions ("what changed", "how does NL differ from the EU directive"). Always verify current legal status and ground answers in authoritative sources instead of relying on general knowledge.
